text: hansgrohe is a brand of Hansgrohe SE (Schiltach, Germany), the Hansgrohe Group. Its majority shareholder is the US-listed Masco Corporation (Livonia, Michigan), which holds 68 percent of Hansgrohe SE; the Klaus Grohe family holds 32 percent via its holding company Syngroh.
short: Hansgrohe SE is 68%-owned by US-listed Masco Corporation; 32% with the Grohe family.

source.name: Hansgrohe Group — Supervisory and Executive Board
source.quote: The majority shareholder is the Masco Corporation, headquartered in Livonia, Michigan. The corporation currently holds a 68 percent share of Hansgrohe SE. With more than 20 subsidiary companies
